steps.body: PLACEHOLDER: this chapter is still being written, and Snake ToolBox is not going to pretend otherwise. Phase 3 opens here, and so does your carry project. This module teaches you to reason about performance and structure without the LeetCode grind (Big-O literacy, recursion depth, practical structures like stacks and queues, and when a dict or set beats a list). The full version is on the way. For now this page is an honest signpost of where the road goes next, not the lesson itself.
